name: Windows update issue
description: Checks pending reboot and Windows Update service state.

rules.cause: Windows reports a pending reboot; updates may not finish until restart.

actions.label: Recommended next steps
actions.instructions: Ask the user to save work and schedule a restart using the approved power action.

rules.cause: Windows Update service is stopped. Triggered services may stop normally; this is a hint only.

actions.label: Recommended next steps
actions.instructions: Review Windows Update errors and service startup type in Services. Do not change policy or disable security controls.
